description:
The deepest known cave on Earth drops over 7,200 feet (2,212 meters) into total darkness.

The Veryovkina Cave is currently the deepest cave ever discovered. Located in the Caucasus Mountains, this massive vertical system pushes human endurance to the limit with freezing temperatures, flooding chambers, narrow shafts, and extreme depth.

Reaching the bottom takes days of technical rope descents through tight passages and underground waterfalls. Expeditions require elite preparation, precision planning, and absolute trust in your equipment.

Would you make it to the bottom?
